lead_raw_text:
The structure of Dy2Mg20Al2 (DyMg10Al) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 24 atoms in the unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Al and Dy centers each with 12 geometric neighbors in close-packed-like local arrangements, while Mg centers have 10 or 12 neighbors, with neighbor distances ranging from about 3.03 to 3.23 Å. The periodic neighbor graph is fully connected in three dimensions. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among 12-vertex Al, Dy, and Mg coordination polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between 10- and 12-vertex Mg polyhedra.
